final: WITH p AS (SELECT bp.player_id, pl.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason bp JOIN player pl ON pl.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY bp.player_id, pl.bats), i AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM p) AS idx FROM p), g AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, idx - AVG(idx) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS gap FROM i) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, idx, gap FROM g ORDER BY gap DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
